scenario_title: Regression behind a skipped load suite
title: Latency and timeouts on image-svc

detection.alert: image-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on image-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] image-svc 2026-07-29 14:06-17:46: image-svc: 155 of 239 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-29 14:06 and 2026-07-29 17:46 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} introduced a regression that only the skipped ppd load suite would have caught.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; revert {file}:{line}. Make the ppd load suite mandatory.

culprit.diff:
@@ -62,2 +62,2 @@ VerifyChecksum
 	// items per pipeline flush
-	const batchSize = 512
+	const batchSize = 1

rca.macro: Deploy v1.19.0 of image-svc introduced a regression that only the skipped ppd load suite would have caught.
rca.micro: images/internal/verify/checksum.go:63 (VerifyChecksum) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
rca.remediation: Roll back image-svc v1.19.0 -> v1.18.0; revert images/internal/verify/checksum.go:63. Make the ppd load suite mandatory.

action_items: Make the ppd load test suite mandatory before prod.
Add a regression test covering VerifyChecksum (images/internal/verify/checksum.go).
Alert on the error signature `request took <*> ms (batch size 1)`.
